services.title: Construction Works
services.shortDescription: Expert construction services for commercial, residential, and infrastructure projects across Tanzania.
services.longDescription: Cmakey Company Limited delivers high-quality construction works from the ground up. Our experienced team handles everything from site preparation and structural engineering to interior finishing, ensuring every project meets international standards while respecting local building codes and community needs.

services.title: Hospitality Services
services.shortDescription: Premier hospitality solutions covering accommodation, catering, and event management in Dar es Salaam.
services.longDescription: Our hospitality division provides world-class services across accommodation, catering, conference facilities, and event management. We combine warm Tanzanian hospitality with international service standards to create memorable experiences for guests and clients alike.

services.title: Entertainment Services
services.shortDescription: Dynamic entertainment solutions for events, corporate functions, and cultural celebrations.
services.longDescription: Cmakey's entertainment division brings creativity and professionalism to every occasion. From corporate events and product launches to cultural festivals and private parties, we provide end-to-end entertainment solutions that captivate audiences and leave lasting impressions.

services.title: Clearing & Forwarding
services.shortDescription: Efficient customs clearance and freight forwarding services through all Tanzanian ports and borders.
services.longDescription: Navigate Tanzania's import and export regulations with confidence. Our clearing and forwarding experts handle all customs documentation, duty assessments, and port procedures—ensuring your cargo moves smoothly through Dar es Salaam Port and border crossings without unnecessary delays.
features: Compliance with TCRA and TRA regulations

services.title: Logistics Services
services.shortDescription: Comprehensive logistics and supply chain management for businesses of all sizes.
services.longDescription: From first-mile collection to last-mile delivery, Cmakey's logistics arm powers seamless supply chains across Tanzania and the East African region. We combine a modern fleet, experienced drivers, and robust tracking systems to ensure your goods arrive on time, every time.

services.title: General Material Supply
services.shortDescription: Reliable procurement and supply of general materials, equipment, and consumables.
services.longDescription: Cmakey acts as a trusted procurement partner, sourcing and supplying a diverse range of materials—from construction supplies and industrial equipment to office consumables and perishables. Our supplier network ensures competitive pricing, quality assurance, and timely delivery.

projects.title: Kilwa Road Expansion Phase II
projects.description: Major structural enhancement and road expansion to improve traffic flow in the southern corridor of Dar es Salaam.

projects.title: Mining Equipment Port Clearance
projects.description: Successfully cleared and forwarded heavy-duty mining machinery through Dar es Salaam Port within record time, ensuring zero downtime for the client.

projects.title: Eco-Logic Logistics Network
projects.description: Multi-border specialized logistics for renewable energy components, including solar panels and wind turbine sections.

projects.title: Corporate Summit Hospitality
projects.description: End-to-end hospitality management for the 2023 East Africa Investment Summit, catering to over 500 regional delegates.

projects.title: Dar Night Marathon Entertainment
projects.description: Full event production including sound, lighting, and cultural performances for the city's premier night-time sporting event.

projects.title: Heavy Machinery Supply Contract
projects.description: Procurement and supply of critical industrial materials and heavy-duty machinery for governmental infrastructure projects.
